servers.name: EDITH Core MCP (Dev + Notes + Web)
servers.description: Built-in MCP server with code search, git diff stat, web page fetcher, and quick personal notes.
servers.setup_hint: Built-in — works immediately with zero external setup.

servers.name: Gmail MCP
servers.description: Search, read, draft, and send Gmail messages directly from EDITH.
servers.setup_hint: Requires Node.js (npx) and Google OAuth desktop JSON (~/.gmail-mcp/gcp-oauth.keys.json).

servers.name: Google Calendar MCP
servers.description: Check today's schedule, create calendar events, and manage RSVPs.
servers.setup_hint: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS to your Google Cloud OAuth credentials.json path.

servers.name: WhatsApp MCP
servers.description: Search WhatsApp contacts, read recent chats, and send messages.
servers.setup_hint: Provide WhatsApp Cloud API token & Phone Number ID (or local whatsapp-mcp bridge).

servers.name: GitHub MCP
servers.description: Inspect repositories, pull requests, issues, branches, and commit logs.
servers.setup_hint: Add a GitHub Personal Access Token (GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN).

servers.name: Playwright Browser MCP
servers.description: Automate live websites, test web apps, click forms, and capture screenshots.

servers.name: Projects Filesystem MCP
servers.description: Standard MCP filesystem access scoped to your c:\Projects folder.
servers.setup_hint: Requires Node.js (npx). Scoped safely to c:\Projects.

servers.name: Notion Workspace MCP
servers.description: Search Notion pages, update docs, trackers, and meeting notes.
servers.setup_hint: Add your Notion Internal Integration Token (NOTION_API_KEY).

servers.name: PostgreSQL DB MCP
servers.description: Inspect schemas and run safe read-only SQL queries on external Postgres DBs.
servers.setup_hint: Set POSTGRES_URL or update the connection string in args.
